knimeNode.name: Crossover
knimeNode.shortDescription: Applies ordinary or Differential Evolution crossover.

fullDescription.intro: Automatically reads decision variables, bounds, objectives, and constraints from Problem Setup. Provides SBX, uniform, one-point, arithmetic, DE binomial, and DE exponential crossover. DE modes combine each mutant with its original target and remove all temporary donor data.

ports.outPort: Unevaluated offspring with the normal population schema.
